study type: Interrupted time-series analysis using a nationwide observational database
exposure: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) during the COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: 3,920,558 live births in Korea between 2011 and 2020.
finding: The study found no significant change in the trend of preterm birth rates in Korea after the implementation of NPIs during the COVID-19 pandemic, with the rates continuing to increase as they had been since 2011.
